infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GraminVikas 360 requires camera access to capture tamper-proof geotagged inspection photos of PMAY-G houses.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GraminVikas 360 requires high-accuracy GPS coordinates to verify physical house construction sites against spatial geo-fences.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allows field inspectors to upload saved milestone pictures for verification.
